description: Opaque dark moss-green knee-length wool tunic with tan Celtic knotwork trim at the neckline, vertical front, sleeve ends and hem. A cream linen undershirt shows at the wrists. Dark green wool cloak crosses the chest and fastens at one shoulder with a large round gold-colored knotwork brooch; the cloak has tan knotwork woven borders and fringe. A brown leather belt with a round decorated clasp carries a long ornamented hanging strap. Loose brown woven trousers and tall brown leather lace-bound boots complete the clothing. The clothed build appears moderate. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
